# GitLab 19.x review API fixtures

Redacted, minimized shapes from the GitLab 19.x Discussions and Merge Requests API documentation examples. These examples follow the API documentation. They are not live deployment captures. Usernames, IDs, paths, and SHAs are replaced. Live GitLab validation remains a deployment acceptance step.

- https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/
- https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/#list-merge-request-diff-versions
- https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/#retrieve-a-merge-request-diff-version
